parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, resulting in a significant drop in val_bpb from 1.042969 to 1.016710. The extra capacity seems to pay off even within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try increasing depth further or adjusting the learning rate to accommodate the deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to stabilize the deeper model and potentially capture more complex patterns.
